name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text field with a label, hint, and error message linked through ARIA.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text linked to the textarea through for/id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint text below the textarea. Hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Turns on aria-invalid and the danger border.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of visible rows. Users can still resize the height vertically.

props.name: value / defaultValue / v-model / bind:value / [(value)]
props.description: Initial content. Blade and Astro use the value prop, React value or defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value or [(value)].

a11y: The label is linked to the textarea through the for and id attributes.
Error and hint text are announced by screen readers through aria-describedby.
aria-invalid is set when the error prop is filled.

ai.whenToUse: Long text input in a form: bio, address, notes, message.
rules: Always set a label, never rely on placeholder alone

id.description: Kolom teks beberapa baris dengan label, petunjuk, dan pesan error yang terhubung lewat ARIA.

props.label: Teks label yang terhubung ke textarea lewat for/id.
props.hint: Teks petunjuk di bawah textarea. Disembunyikan saat ada error.
props.error: Pesan error. Mengaktifkan aria-invalid dan border danger.
props.rows: Jumlah baris yang terlihat. Pengguna tetap bisa mengubah tinggi secara vertikal.
props.id: Id textarea. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.
props.value / defaultValue / v-model / bind:va: Isi awal. Blade dan Astro memakai prop value, React value atau defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value atau [(value)].

a11y: Label terhubung ke textarea lewat atribut for dan id.
Pesan error dan petunjuk dibacakan screen reader lewat aria-describedby.
aria-invalid aktif saat prop error terisi.

ai.whenToUse: Isian teks panjang di form: bio, alamat, catatan, pesan.
rules: Selalu isi label, jangan hanya placeholder
Pakai Input untuk teks satu baris
